name: ruflo-rure
description: Statically analyze a local JS/Electron app you're authorized to study, with file+line evidence, and build an original reimplementation of what you find. Experimental. Phase 1: JS/Electron static analysis. Phase 2: native ELF/PE/Mach-O container inspection. Parses, never executes. .NET, EVM, and dynamic analysis are future phases, not yet implemented.
